title: Endocrine System - Negative Feedback in Blood Glucose Regulation
body:
Study the diagram showing blood glucose regulation:

```
[BLOOD GLUCOSE HOMEOSTASIS]

              NORMAL BLOOD GLUCOSE
                   (90 mg/dL)
                      |
         +------------+------------+
         |                         |
    [INCREASE]                [DECREASE]
    After eating              During fasting
         |                         |
         v                         v
    High blood               Low blood
    glucose                  glucose
         |                         |
         v                         v
    BETA CELLS              ALPHA CELLS
    in Pancreas             in Pancreas
         |                         |
         v                         v
    Release                 Release
    INSULIN                 GLUCAGON
         |                         |
         v                         v
    - Glucose uptake        - Glycogen breakdown
      by cells                (glycogenolysis)
    - Glycogen storage      - Gluconeogenesis
      (glycogenesis)          in liver
         |                         |
         v                         v
    Blood glucose           Blood glucose
    DECREASES               INCREASES
         |                         |
         +----------->  <----------+
                   |
              HOMEOSTASIS
              (Balance restored)
```

Explain how the body responds when blood glucose rises after a meal, including the hormone involved and its effects.
